title: Rules Committee
summary: Prepared the procedural framework by which the Constituent Assembly would govern motions, amendments, elections, committees and adjournment.

title: States Negotiating Committee
summary: Negotiated representation of Indian States, later received authority around Bhutan and Sikkim, and by April had produced an agreed route for State representatives to enter the Assembly.

title: Credentials Committee
summary: Part of the Assembly's standing institutional machinery dealing with member credentials.

title: House Committee
summary: Part of the internal administrative machinery required to sustain the Assembly's sessions.

title: Finance & Staff Committee
summary: Handled the Assembly's expenditure and staffing arrangements; its work returns in the January budget debates.

title: Steering Committee
summary: Coordinates the Assembly's programme of business. In April the House begins filling additional places reserved for representatives of Indian States.

title: Advisory Committee
meta: Created 24 January 1947 · rights report reaches House in April
summary: Charged with fundamental rights, minority safeguards and tribal/excluded areas; its interim Fundamental Rights work becomes Assembly business from 29 April 1947.

title: Business Committee
summary: Three-member body created to recommend the order of further constitution-making business before the Assembly resumed in April.

title: Committee on Subjects Assigned to the Union Centre
summary: Examined the scope and interconnection of Union subjects. Its April report is explicitly provisional because political developments may require the federal framework to be reconsidered.
